description: An Order (r2) waits for the Inventory (r1) it holds a `ref` to. Host code closes the Inventory, which ends `done`; its driver then pushes `{"kind": "ended", "from": "r1", "status": "Done"}` onto the Order's queue, since the Order's machine has an `on inventory.ended`. The Order takes it as an `event` record, its guard on `event.status` sends it to Closed, and its timer is cancelled.
